title: Governing the Commons
author: Elinor Ostrom
takeaway: Communities can manage shared resources without a king or a market, if the rules are local.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
takeaway: Treat the gene as the unit that is trying to persist.

title: Working in Public
author: Nadia Eghbal

author: M. Mitchell Waldrop
